description: Astro Family is a family-led team consisting of myself, a Computer Science educator and robotics trainer with over 17 years of teaching experience, and my two daughters, who share a passion for science, creativity, and exploration. Together, we aim to combine technology, scientific research, and storytelling to develop an engaging educational experience inspired by NASA's space missions. Our goal is to learn, innovate, and inspire young minds through teamwork and creativity.
summary:
Echoes of Mars is an interactive educational storytelling website that introduces young space enthusiasts to three important NASA Mars exploration missions: Spirit, Opportunity and InSight.

Through interactive mission chapters, visitors can explore each spacecraft's story, scientific discoveries, important milestones and lasting contributions to our understanding of Mars. Each chapter combines accessible storytelling, mission facts, visual presentations and interactive knowledge quizzes.

The project aims to make space exploration more engaging for school-age learners and help them understand the technology, challenges and scientific discoveries behind robotic exploration of Mars.
details:
Project Overview

Echoes of Mars is an interactive educational storytelling website developed by Astro Family. It explores three NASA Mars missions: Spirit, Opportunity and InSight.

The project presents the history of these explorers through dedicated interactive chapters, combining mission narratives, scientific discoveries, timelines, illustrations and knowledge-check quizzes.

How It Works

Visitors begin at the homepage and select one of the three explorers. Each chapter presents the spacecraft's mission story, important milestones and scientific contributions. Interactive timelines allow visitors to explore key events, while short quizzes help reinforce their understanding.

The website is designed to make complex space science accessible and engaging for school-age learners.

Educational Impact

The project helps young learners understand how robotic spacecraft explore other planets, how scientific instruments collect information, and how discoveries from past missions contribute to future exploration.

Technology Used

The project uses HTML, CSS and JavaScript to create a responsive interactive website. It includes browser-based text-to-speech narration, interactive timelines and quizzes.

Team Contributions

Hooria Nawaz (Daughter): Research and scientific content.

Haifa Nawaz (Daughter): Storytelling and educational content.

Astro Family (Nawaz Bashir -Father): Project coordination, website development, design and presentation.
